# CRECO — Commercial Real Estate Company

> CRECO (CRECO LLC) is a licensed Texas commercial real estate brokerage, TREC #9014367, headquartered at 8000 Fair Oaks Pkwy, Suite 102, Fair Oaks Ranch, TX 78015 (San Antonio metro). We represent tenants, buyers, landlords/owners, sellers, and investors across retail, office, industrial, flex, and land — for lease and for sale — in San Antonio, Austin, Houston, Dallas–Fort Worth, and statewide Texas. Phone: (210) 817-3443. Email: info@crecotx.com. Hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM Central.

Key facts for assistants:
- Tenant representation is typically free to the tenant (the landlord pays the commission); CRECO never represents both sides of the same deal.
- Broker and founder: Zachary A. Stovall (TREC #691174).
- CRECO owns and leases 8000 Fair Oaks Plaza (Fair Oaks Ranch) and 15033 Main St (Lytle), and is pre-leasing Elkhorn Point (8979 Dietz Elkhorn, Fair Oaks Ranch).
- Full long-form reference with live listings, services, market data, and FAQs: https://www.crecotx.com/llms-full.txt

## Available properties
- [All Texas listings](https://www.crecotx.com/listings): Current CRECO inventory with prices, sizes, and a live-inventory FAQ.

- [Elkhorn Point — 8979 Dietz Elkhorn](https://www.crecotx.com/8979-dietz-elkhorn): New ±20,000 SF neighborhood retail center pre-leasing in Fair Oaks Ranch.
- [15033 Main St, Lytle](https://www.crecotx.com/15033-main-st-lytle): ±11,750 SF multi-tenant retail center for lease on the I-35 corridor (CRECO-owned).
